Day-by-day itinerary

  1. Day 1Sigiriya

    Meet your driver at the airport, stop at Dambulla Market and climb Lion Rock.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  2. Day 2Kandy

    Visit the Big Buddha, the Temple of the Tooth and Kandy Lake. Pidurangala is optional.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  3. Day 3Ella

    Stop at Ravana Falls and the Nine Arch Bridge.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  4. Day 4Gal Oya

    Hike Little Adam’s Peak before an evening boat safari in Gal Oya.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  5. Day 5Galle

    Take a morning wildlife drive before visiting Galle Fort.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  6. Day 6South coast

    Spend time snorkelling and visit Jungle Beach and Coconut Tree Hill.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
  7. Day 7Colombo and departure

    Stop at a turtle hatchery and explore Colombo before the airport transfer.

    Find this stop on the map ↗
